summary.text: Larry Hart, a Republican from Topsham, represented the Orange district in the Vermont Senate from 2025 until he resigned on November 14, 2025.

paragraphs.text: Hart served as a United States Marine and later owned NAPA stores in Randolph and Bradford, according to his Senate biography.
He is American Legion Commander for Orange County and for Earl Brock Post 20 of Bradford.
He is a Justice of the Peace for the Town of Topsham after nine years on its selectboard, and he is a member of the Middle Branch and Riverside Granges.
He lives in Topsham with his wife, Emily Waterman-Hart.
